source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of standard candles (PDF 172).

blocks.text: Astronomy (falkiyat) mein stars aur galaxies tak ke faasle napna bohat zaroori hai, kyunke isi se hum kainat ki banawat aur us ka phailna (expansion) samajhte hain.

blocks.title: Standard candles
blocks.text: Standard candles woh aasmani ajsam hain jin ki asal chamak (intrinsic brightness, yani luminosity) pehle se maloom hoti hai. Yeh cosmic faasle napne ke aham auzaar hain.

Standard candle zameen se kitna roshan nazar aata hai (apparent magnitude, zahiri chamak) aur asal mein kitna roshan hai, in dono ka muqabla kar ke astronomers roshni ke inverse-square law se us ka faasla nikal lete hain: F = L/4πd² se d = √(L/4πF). Standard candles ki misalein Cepheid variable stars aur Type Ia supernovae hain. Dono ki luminosity pehle se andaza ki ja sakti hai, is liye yeh faasle ke bharosa-mand nishan hain.

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein; har aik mein daen taraf mom-batti (nuqta source) aur baen taraf phailti lakeerein. Pehli: r par aik panel (I) jis se 16 photons guzarte hain. Doosri: r (I) aur 2r (I/4) par panels; 2r wala panel chaar khanon A ka, aur aik neele khane se 4 photons. Teesri: r, 2r, 3r, 4r par I, I/4, I/9, I/16 aur 1, 4, 9, 16 khane A; 4r par neele khane se 1 photon.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.2: standard candle se faasla napne ka tareeqa (kitab ki Figure 21.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Detector ka area A har jagah aik jaisa hai. r par is mein se 16 photons, 2r par 4 aur 4r par sirf 1 photon guzarta hai, kyunke wahi roshni 4, phir 16 khanon par phail jati hai (I, I/4, I/16). Agar star ki asal chamak maloom ho (standard candle) to photons gin kar faasla nikal sakte hain.

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Standard candles ka khayal 1910 ki dahai se hai, jab Henrietta Swan Leavitt ne dekha ke Cepheid variable stars aik maloom pattern mein dhadakte (pulse karte) hain. Un ke kaam ne cosmic faasle aur kainat ka size napne ki bunyaad rakhi. Standard candles na hotin to hamein yeh bhi pata na hota ke kainat kitni bari hai.

blocks.title: Hal shuda misal (izafi)
blocks.problem: 1.0 × 10³⁰ W luminosity wala Cepheid star zameen par 1.0 × 10⁻¹² W m⁻² flux deta hai. Is ka faasla maloom karein.
steps: F = L/4πd² ko d ke liye hal karein: d = √(L/4πF)

blocks.prompt: Do stars barabar roshan nazar aate hain. Aik standard candle hai jis ki asal chamak maloom hai; doosre ki nahi. Agar standard candle zyada door ho to doosre star ki asal chamak ke bare mein kya keh sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Doosra star qareeb hai lekin utna hi roshan nazar aata hai, is liye us ki asal chamak (luminosity) standard candle se kam hai. Kitni kam: dono ke faaslon ki nisbat (ratio) ke square ke hisaab se.

items: Standard candles: maloom luminosity wale ajsam (Cepheid variables, Type Ia supernovae).
Naapa gaya flux F aur maloom L se faasla: d = √(L/4πF).
